items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 13:1
items.html: If there is no recognition of any discernment whatsoever between the four degrees of the will to receive, they are said to be in a single evenness. (Part 1, Item 1)
